sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Volture nest is a Point of interest found in the Ashlands.
Up to 4 Voltures spawn initially close to a Volture nest with a 100%, 75%, 50% and 25% chance, respectively. These Voltures do not respawn, the Volture nest is not a Creature spawner.
Up to 6 Volture eggs can be found hidden below the nest, with a 50% chance to spawn each.
The nest is surrounded by up to 6 Asksvin carrion, with a 100% chance for the first and 50% chance for the other to spawn.
